title: TMS 402/ACI 530/ASCE 5, Section 2.
officialText: 3.6, maximum bar size. Add the following to Chapter 2: 2.3.6 Maximum bar size. The bar diameter shall not exceed one-eighth of the nominal wall thickness and shall not exceed one-quarter of the least dimension of the cell, course or collar joint in which it is placed.
